subject.title: feat: consume shared OpenClaw design tokens

question: Should this stacked token-consumer PR wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.ai/pull/198 to land and then be refreshed on current main, or should maintainers intentionally review and land the design-system stack as a coordinated branch?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the landing path depends on an open draft base branch, current-main drift in the same layout file, and the shared design-system token contract; automation should not choose that sequencing policy.

options.title: Refresh after the base lands
options.body: Land or replace the design-system install base first, then rebase this token-consumer PR on current main and require fresh proof before merge.

options.title: Coordinate the stacked merge
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally review and land the stack together if they own the current-main conflict resolution and token contract compatibility.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this draft paused if the design-system package contract or release process is not ready for the website repository.

recommendation.title: Refresh after the base lands
recommendation.body: Land or replace the design-system install base first, then rebase this token-consumer PR on current main and require fresh proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main dependency and product-boundary history points to this handle for the landing-sequence decision.
